remarks: Greenwich Rental: Awesome 4BR, 2.5B on a tree-lined cul-de-sac. Cathedral ceiling w/2 skylights in the entry/foyer. LR provides an open concept. High-frequency plug for electric cars. Catwalk overlooks the LR and foyer and connects the 4 upstairs BR's. LR features a gas fireplace and French doors opening to the full-length, rear deck. The eat-in kitchen has stainless-steel appliances with a new stove and granite counter tops, adjoining the DR. Flat-screen TV in the kitchen for tenant use/enjoyment. TV room on the first floor opens to the rear deck, complete with French doors. Multiple solar panels on the rear roof lowers electricity costs. Natural gas generator automatically fires to minimize power loss. Located in the Glenville section of Greenwich, 1/2 mile from a park, playing field, Glenville Elementary School and the Western Greenwich Civic Center, which has its own fitness center, day care and basketball courts. Nearby shopping center sports a large grocery store, across the street from 4 restaurants, a deli, medical & dental offices, a pharmacy, dry cleaners, a bank and a nail salon Gas station within walking distance for auto repairs. 1.5 miles from the Merritt/Hutchinson River Parkways and 3 miles to downtown Greenwich, Greenwich train station and I-95. 3 miles from Byram Beach, the boat launch/boat slips and the town pool. Convenient to the town's golf course. Greenwich Hospital/Yale New Haven Health Center is 3 miles away
